testcase.name: Gate 1: Moto Cloud API is responding at http://localhost:5000
Gate 2a: Hub cluster API is reachable
Gate 2b: All Argo CD core pods are Running
Gate 2c: Both spoke-nonprod and spoke-prod clusters are registered in Argo CD
Gate 4a: Spoke clusters APIs are reachable
Gate 4b: ACK SQS and Kro controllers are ready on both spokes
Gate 3a: Platform baseline and dynamic tenant applications exist
Gate 3b: All platform baseline and dynamic tenant applications are Synced and Healthy
Gate 5: QueueBackedService instances are ACTIVE across dev, test, and prod
Gate 7: Workload pods are Running across non-prod and prod spokes
Gate 6: All 6 SQS queues and DLQs exist in their designated CARM cloud accounts
Gate 6b: Each CARM account has exactly one platform VPC, the one Kubernetes references
Gate 9: Orders flow end-to-end and are processed across dev, test, and prod
Gate 9b: Each spoke load balancer routes every request (no stale upstream after a restart)
Gate 8: Cluster and Headlamp credentials are valid and unexpired
Gate 10a: OIDC issuer is identical from host and from argocd-server
Gate 10b: Argo CD advertises Keycloak SSO (PKCE)
Gate 10c: SSO entry points reach Keycloak login form
Gate 10d: Local platform-admin break-glass login succeeds
Gate 10e: Headlamp requires SSO and refuses cross-origin access
Gate 11a: Kyverno image verification policy tenant-images-signed is enforcing Deny, and every tenant namespace and the probe namespace opt in
Gate 11b: Kyverno denies unsigned image and native VAP denies arbitrary unallowlisted image
Gate 11c: Running signed workload image is admitted
Gate 11d: Policy Reporter: reports controller and APIs on both spokes (routes need credentials), UI on the hub behind Keycloak
Gate 12a: Hub Prometheus receives scrape metrics from both spokes
Gate 12b: Synthetic HTTP blackbox probes are healthy
Gate 12c: Logs shipped from hub, spoke-nonprod and spoke-prod, and Loki is up
Gate 12d: Discovered TeamEKSCluster claims report ready in Prometheus
Gate 12e: No alerts persistently firing over 20 minutes
Gate 12f: Grafana SSO entry point reaches Keycloak login form
Gate 12g: Hub receives Policy Reporter metrics from both spokes
Gate 14: Bats report viewer is ready and has prior results
Gate 14a: ACK S3 report bucket is synced in the nonprod account
